reason: I've never heard of FLUGIA and I'm not handing my CRM, email and customers to an unknown company's AI. I might book the free demo out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay this month until I see it actually bring me leads or save me hours.
objection: Who are these people and will they still be around in two years? If I spend weeks setting this up and they disappear, I've lost my time and maybe my data. Also, what is a 'credit' and how far do 100 go?
